title: Proxy & Gateway
content:
Photon is highly optimized for building API Gateways and Reverse Proxies. By leveraging fetch and zero-copy streaming, header transformation is nearly instant.

The Proxy Pattern

In the standalone engine, you can easily create a reverse proxy using the native fetch API. Photon's minimal overhead ensures that your gateway remains efficient.

// Simple Proxy Pattern
app.all('/legacy-api/*', async (c) => {
  const url = new URL(c.req.url)
  const target = 'https://old-service.internal' + url.pathname
  
  return fetch(target, {
    method: c.req.method,
    headers: c.req.headers(),
    body: c.req.raw.body
  })
})

Router-level Orchestration

For high-performance API Gateways, combine Photon's AOT routing with service discovery to route requests to your internal microservices.

Performance Note: Gravito's AOT router makes proxy matching O(1), ensuring that even with thousands of gateway rules, the overhead remains sub-millisecond.
